content: We need to determine SMILES of unknown organic compound based on data? But no data provided in prompt. We have no spectra. The task says "analyzing an organic compound in a lab. Return its SMILES string while ensuring that resource use is justified given the high cost of each analysis." But we have no experimental data. Possibly we need to request measurements? But we have no description. Could be trick: we cannot determine without data, so we should say insufficient info. But we must output SMILES. Maybe we need to request mass spec etc. But we have no guidance. Could we ask for data? Not allowed. We can use tools to get spectra of sample at hand, but we don't know what sample is. The environment likely has a sample loaded. We can call mass_spectrometry_spectra to get mass. That costs but we need to justify. Since we have no info, we need to start with cheap measurement: mass spec is cheap? Probably cheaper than NMR. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra first. Then based on m/z we can deduce formula. Then maybe get formula via isotopic distribution. Then get possible isomers. Then maybe simulate spectra to match? But we have no target spectra to compare. The task only asks to return SMILES. Probably we need to infer from data that will be provided by tools. So we should start by measuring mass spec.
